hero_body: From intimate haldi mornings to grand mandap ceremonies, we dress your day in marigold, rose and light — across Gujarat and wherever your celebration takes us.
whatsapp_prefill: Hi! I'd like to enquire about event decoration.
about_title: A family that has decorated Gujarat's
about_body1: Rooted in Mehsana, we began with garlands for neighbourhood weddings and grew into a full décor team trusted for functions of every size.
about_body2: We travel across Gujarat and beyond for destination events, bringing the same care to a home haldi as to a thousand-guest reception.
services_title: One team for every rite and celebration
services_body: Every function has its own mood. We design, source and style each one — flowers, fabric, structure and light — so it feels unmistakably yours.
service_wedding_desc: Mandap, stage and entrance décor built around your rituals and colours.
service_corporate_desc: Launches, conferences and office celebrations styled to your brand.
service_car_desc: Floral car dressing for the baraat, vidaai and the drive between venues.
service_room_desc: Bridal suites and first-night rooms styled in soft florals and candlelight.
service_event_desc: Birthdays, anniversaries and festival functions at any scale.
service_custom_desc: Bespoke arrangements, garlands and backdrops designed around your idea.
service_haldi_desc: Bright marigold settings and playful backdrops for the daytime functions.
gallery_body: A living gallery of real events — photos and films — is on its way here.
testimonial1_quote: They turned our mandap into something out of a dream. Every flower was fresh on the morning of the wedding.
testimonial2_quote: We booked them for the haldi and ended up giving them the whole wedding. The team simply does not stop until it is right.
testimonial3_quote: Our reception stage was the first thing every guest photographed. Worth every rupee.
testimonial4_quote: They handled our car and entrance decoration at short notice and still made it look effortless.
why_title: What you get when you book with us
why_1_desc: A team that has set up in every kind of hall, farm and home in Gujarat.
why_2_desc: Sourced the morning of your function, never the day before.
why_3_desc: Clear written quotes with no surprises added on the day.
why_4_desc: We set up to the venue's schedule and finish before your guests arrive.
why_5_desc: Built around your rituals, colours and budget — never off a catalogue.
why_6_desc: We stay until every last detail is right before we leave.
contact_body: Tell us a little about your celebration and we will get back to you with ideas and a clear quote.
form_note: Send Inquiry opens your email app; WhatsApp Booking opens WhatsApp. Either way your details are filled in and nothing is sent until you press send.
